text:
oya: Blocking note  Sable Compute invoice INV-SB-209 is on hold. Vendor reissued with a different PO and new bank in the same packet.

ben: Can someone paste the PO printed on the invoice PDF? Ill try auto-match.

oya: PDF shows PO = SB-ACQ-0012. Our PO master shows SB-2026-778 as the active PO after the supplier split.

lucy: Quick context: Sable split into two payment entities last month. AP reissued invoice and accidentally used the legacy PO. Correct PO should be SB-2026-778. They also changed receiving bank to the new payments entity.

```
legacy_account: SABLE-OLD-01
new_account: SABLE-PAY-77 (effective 2026-04-18)
```

reza: Procurement needs an entity confirmation doc + tax ID to reconcile. Im remote for a few hours.

approvals-bot: Hold created: reasons=[PO_MISMATCH, BANK_CHANGE]; actions_required=[attach_po_mapping_doc, vendor_bank_ownership, procurement_confirm_or_finance_2up].

ben: Two paths: wait for procurement or do a 2-up finance signoff for this run. Is this urgent? Vendor flagged potential late interest after 6 days.

lucy: Uploading signed amendment that maps SB-ACQ-0012 -> SB-2026-778 and includes vendor EIN. Also attached bank ownership proof. Link: https://files.sable.example/INV-SB-209-amend.pdf

oya: Please include a short audit note with GL and cost center if we want Billing to push a treasury override. This is infra consumption.

ben: If Oya posts GL and Reza (or Procurement) can't confirm in time, I can request treasury manual override but we need two approvals.

oya: GL=5406-training-infra; cost_center=platform-gpu-prod. Audit note: "Temporary finance release requested pending procurement reconfirmation; documents attached."

approvals-bot: Documents attached. Pending: [treasury_manual_override_request, procurement_reconcile_ticket].

ben: Submitted manual override to Treasury with ref "Sable split entities; temporary finance 2-up; docs attached." ETA 24-48h. Flagged urgent.

reza: Ill open a procurement ticket on return and set priority high to reconcile PO mapping and supplier entity. If procurement finds an issue, we will document and remediate.

lucy: Vendor asked for confirmation once payment initiates. Theyre sensitive due to vendor-side payroll.

oya: Noted. Ill watch the batch and update once treasury confirms. If treasury rejects, escalate to Finance Manager.

ben: Summary: amendment + bank ownership attached; GL set; manual override requested; approvals-bot hold remains until procurement reconciles or treasury approves.

lucy: Thanks all :pray:
_meta: Slack thread export: vendor split created PO mismatch + bank change; root message and replies in chronological order
